verdict.rationale: Letta lets users choose to run entirely on self-hosted infrastructure (App Server) instead of Letta Cloud, giving control over where agent data physically resides, and local CLI mode keeps state on-device without any account (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-31, letta-probe-rt-2). However there is no documentation of region/data-residency selection within Letta Cloud itself (e.g., choosing EU vs US hosting), so this only partially satisfies the story for cloud users. Missing for 10: explicit multi-region or residency selection options for Letta Cloud, compliance/certification documentation (SOC2, GDPR data-location guarantees).
